args.rationale: The baseline projection shows usable inventory of 350 units against a horizon demand of 700 units (25 units/day). Without action, inventory drops below safety stock (200 units) on 2026-09-23 and encounters a stockout starting 2026-10-01, resulting in 350 units of unmet demand and 22 days below safety stock. Placing a PO for 550 units with SUP-A (expected receipt date 2026-09-20) eliminates all 350 units of unmet demand, prevents any days below safety stock, and yields a closing inventory of 200 units (8.0 days of cover, within the max 12 days cover policy). The order cost of $1,650.00 is fully within the available budget of $5,000.00 and autonomy spend limit of $2,000.00. Therefore, the recommended order of 550 units is accepted.
